correctness.rationale: In the even-subset model of J[2], complementary subsets are identified and the symplectic pairing is intersection parity. Distinct nonzero classes have unique pair representatives; they are orthogonal just when the pairs are disjoint, so the fifteen maximal isotropics correspond equivariantly to matchings. In odd characteristic these kernels are étale, and the polarization descends to a principal polarization on the quotient by a maximal isotropic subgroup. Independently reproduced every row without enumerating matchings: a fixed matching pairs the cycles of a permutation among equal-length cycles (d offsets for a matched pair of d-cycles), or self-matches an even cycle by its unique antipodal involution. The fixed count on m cycles of length d therefore has recurrence F_m = [2 divides d] F_(m−1) + (m−1)d F_(m−2), with F_0=1 and F_1=[2 divides d]. Apply this to powers and subtract proper-divisor contributions to recover cycle multiplicities. The rational torsion count is 1 + (# of branch 2-cycles) + choose(# of fixed branch points, 2). All eleven rows, both collisions and the irreducible sextic case agree. Zeta is the product over closed-point orbits; its power fixed counts recover the orbit multiplicities. Squares in F7 are 0,1,2,4, so the two displayed quadratics are distinct irreducibles and the displayed sextics are squarefree. Finite-field irreducible counts for degrees up to six suffice for all partitions at q≥7.
residual_risks: This concerns kernels rather than quotient-isomorphism classes or rational generators. For the general verifier math.lcm requires Python 3.9 or later.

value.rationale: The finite étale kernel scheme is a natural object and the distinction between a rational kernel and rational generators is useful. But the claimed spectra, non-determination of the torsion order and irreducible-branch example of descent without generators are mechanically read from the simultaneous prior action table under classical identifications. The two explicit sextics are routine realizations of the two already distinguishable partitions, not a further structural result or a nontrivial realization boundary. No distinct valuable mathematical remainder is established in this record.
residual_risks: The repackaging may have expository utility; the assessment is about distinct scientific value of the stated finding.
